content:
Although 《乜都得教練》(Ted Lasso) Season 4 still has several new episodes yet to air, according to a recent report by Sigmund Judge, audiences may not have to wait too long after the Season 4 finale for Season 5.

Reports indicate that Apple will begin filming 《乜都得教練》 Season 5 in January next year.

When 《乜都得教練》 Season 3 concluded in 2023, the entire series felt as though it had reached a definitive ending. Although many viewers (and even the cast) hoped the show could continue, its prospects remained uncertain.

Now that 《乜都得教練》 has finally returned, all signs point to Apple and Jason Sudeikis planning several more seasons.

A series of posts published today by Sigmund Judge on X has brought good news on this front.

Judge had previously broken exclusive news about 《乜都得教練》 and other Apple TV+ related series with accuracy.

With filming set to begin in a few months, there is a strong chance we will see 《乜都得教練》 Season 5 return on Apple TV+ in 2027.

New episodes of Season 4 will continue airing until October 7, so there is still plenty of Lasso content to enjoy during this period. Although Apple has yet to officially confirm the renewal, there is a high possibility of announcing the start of production for Season 5 as Season 4 wraps up.

On a related note, another Apple series from 《乜多得教練》 co-creator Bill Lawrence, 《Bad Monkey》, will return later this year, while his other popular series 《Shrinking》 is expected to premiere its fourth season in early 2027.

Season 5 of 《乜都得教練》 is going into production so soon — are you looking forward to it? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV+ costs US$12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed through the Apple One bundle.
